description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the Aws\DefaultsMode namespace. It provides methods for creating configuration providers that load AWS SDK default configurations from environment variables, ini files, or fallback options, and supports composition and caching of these providers.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to create and manage AWS SDK configuration providers, supporting environment variables, ini files, fallback options, and caching.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, ini files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that loads configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options when other sources are not set.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that loads configuration from a specified ini file and profile.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface object.
